name: Sonnet deep value
strategy: Deep value equal-weight basket of US large/mid-caps trading at low P/E, low P/B, and high FCF yield, screened from pre-2026-cutoff knowledge across financials, energy, autos, healthcare, and industrials — sectors chronically out of favor but generating strong cash flow. Avoids high-multiple growth/tech to maximize valuation margin of safety versus the cap-weighted S&P 500.

orders.reason: Structurally challenged staples portfolio, weak organic growth, cutting from deep-value basket despite low P/E.
Cyclical auto value trap risk amid tariff/EV-transition uncertainty; H1 underperformance confirms thesis stalling.
European telecom value trap with weak FCF conversion; rotating into higher-quality domestic value.
Depressed single-digit P/E healthcare franchise (PBM+retail+Aetna) trading well below book, high FCF yield post-guidance-reset.
Low P/E, aggressive buybacks, strong FCF yield fintech trading at a steep discount to historical multiple.
Low P/E, low P/B hardware name with steady FCF and shareholder returns, classic deep-value profile.
Refiner with high FCF yield and low P/B, cheap cyclical energy value exposure to diversify basket.

outlook: Expect deep-value laggards (healthcare, fintech, refining, hardware) to mean-revert as H2 broadens out beyond AI-infrastructure leadership, while trimming staples/auto/European telecom names showing structural rather than cyclical weakness.
